item.title: [NE Reps] [SNECxVIAC collaboration] Re: All classes supporting Toy Buffet 2026
item.description: Hey Hwa Chong! 👋 In the spirit of this year's National Day theme, "Majulah Singapura, Go Beyond!", the 14th Students' National Education Council and Values-in-Action Council are organising a Toy Donation Drive (in support for Food From The Heart’s annual Toy Buffet) to bring joy to children in need — because going beyond our usual connections means showing kindness and strengthening our community as we celebrate Singapore's 61st birthday. (Interested to read about past iterations of Toy Buffet? See https://www.foodfromtheheart.sg/highlights/toy-buffet-2025-245) For a class of 25 students, do divide into 5 groups of 5 students, with each group preparing one toy for a child aged 5–12 years old. This is a chance to practise empathy and generosity as a team. Before the timetabled CT period in T3W6/W7, groups should discuss and agree on a suitable toy to buy and why, then decide on one member to make the purchase, with the rest reimbursing them. During CT period, each group will write an encouraging message to accompany their gift and wrap it with care. Please read the details attached below for how to make this toy collection a meaningful success! Warmest regards, SNEC & VIAC ❤️ __________________________________________________________________________ Toy Guidelines 🎁 No soft toys allowed due to hygiene and allergen considerations. Brand-new toys are preferred, but preloved toys are also welcomed, provided they are clean, in GREAT condition, and come with complete packaging. Toys should be meaningful and fall under one of the following categories: 1. Board Games 2. Games Set 3. Educational 4. Building 5. Creative Making 6. Sports 7. Dolls/Robots 8. Electronic Please see the attached image for details. Wrapping & Message Writing 📝 During the Term 3 Week 6 / 7 class CT period, classes will wrap the 5 toys they have prepared beforehand and write 5 heartfelt messages (one for each toy) into the 5 cards collected by your NE Reps. Please let your CT vet and approve the messages before inserting the cards into the wrapped presents . You may wish to refer to the examples below: "We hope you will enjoy and like this toy as much as we did because it brought us so many unforgettable game nights full of laughter and friendly competition. May it bring your favourite people together for endless fun, strategic thinking, and clever moves!" "We hope you will enjoy and like this toy as much as we did because it gave us so many different ways to play, challenge each other, and share big smiles. May it keep your days exciting and turn every afternoon into a brand-new adventure!" 'We hope you will enjoy and like this toy as much as we did because it let us bring our wildest imaginations to life, piece by piece. May it inspire you to dream big, test your ideas, and build incredible creations you are proud of!" 1. Transparent wrapping materials (55 x 55 cm) and cards will be provided to each class. 2. NE Reps are to collect these materials at the SNIAC Room between 0740hrs and 0800hrs on the day allocated in the collection schedule below. 3. Classes are reminded to bring their own clear tape, scissors and colouring stationery to decorate the cards. Collection Details (for the toys that are wrapped) Date 📅: 3 – 21 August 2026 Time ⏰: 1500-1700h Venue📍: SNIAC Room (next to Printing Shop) NE and CT reps are to bring the wrapped toys and completed messages to the SNIAC Room during the above time period on the day allocated in the collection schedule below Classes are to keep the toys with them until the end of the day, and are reminded not to leave the toys in the classroom Toys Collection Schedule (1500-1700h) Even Monday (3 August 2026) 25A13 25A15 25S61 25S62 25S63 25S67 25S6B 25S6C 25S6E 25S6F 25S70 25S71 25S74 25S76 26S60 26S62 26S65 26S67 26S6G 26S6N Even Tuesday (4 August 2026) 25A10 25A14 25S64 25S6G 25S6N 25S6P 25S75 25S7B 25S7D 26A11 26A12 26A14 26S63 26S64 26S69 26S6B 26S6C 26S6F 26S6H 26S6K 26S6Q 26S6T 26S6V 26S71 26S72 26S73 26S74 26S7B 26S7C Even Thursday (6 August 2026) 25A11 25A12 25S65 25S69 25S6A 25S6D 25S6Q 25S6V Odd Tuesday (11 August 2026) 25S68 25S6T 25S72 26A15 26S77 26S78 Odd Wednesday (12 August 2026) 26S70 26S75 26S7A 26S7D Odd Thursday (13 August 2026) 25S66 25S6K 25S73 25S78 25S79 26S6A 26S6P 26S79 26S7E Odd Friday (14 August 2026) 25S6H 25S77 26S61 26S66 26S6D Even Friday (21 August 2026) 25S60 25S7A 26A13 26S68 26S76
